name: WARNING: Goya Sazón with Culantro & Achiote (MSG, Salt & Artificial Dyes)
whyItWorks: Convenience packet containing monosodium glutamate (MSG) as its primary ingredient, along with Yellow 5, Red 40, and garlic powder. Artificial azo dyes and heavy glutamate can exacerbate gut permeability and cramping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: For golden Latin rice color, use natural ground turmeric and pure annatto oil rather than Goya Sazón packets.
